question:
Choose the correct set of the names for the organic compounds in the given figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74a908762ead42e33992df5ade2872edd931fbeeac36dcc1473813b2274a95d3.png]

options.text: a: Furan, b: Toluene, c: Pyridine
a: Furan, b: Pyridine, c: Thiophene
a: Furan, b: Thiophene, c: Aniline
a: Anisole, b: Thiophene, c: Pyridine

solution:
The correct answer is a: Furan, b: Pyridine, c: Thiophene [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Furan **is a **heterocyclic organic compound** containing a **five-membered aromatic ring** with **one oxygen **atom.
 
• **Toluene** is a **colorless liquid **with a **sweet, pungent odor**.
 
 
• It is a **common solvent **and used as a precursor to many chemicals.
 
 
 
• **Pyridine** is a** heterocyclic aromatic compound** with a **six-membered ring** containing **five carbon atoms** and **one nitrogen atom.**
 
 
• It is used as a **solvent, catalyst, and precursor **to many chemicals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thiophene** is a** heterocyclic compound **containing a **five-membered aromatic ring **with **one sulfur **atom.

 
 
• It is used as a **solvent **and in the production of **pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals.**
 
 
 
• **Aniline** is an **aromatic amine** with a **benzene ring** and a primary **amine group**.
 
 
• It is used in the production of **dyes, pharmaceuticals, and rubber processing chemicals.**
 
 
 
• **Anisole** is an organic compound with a **methoxy group (-OCH3)** attached to a benzene ring.
 
 
• It is used as a** solvent** and in the production of **perfumes and flavors.**
